title: KOTORY: Robust Three-Group Tests for Heteroscedasticity in Linear Regression
description:
R package implementing two tests for heteroscedasticity in linear regression. The observations are sorted by a regressor or by any other variable (for example time) and split into three equal parts; the regression is fitted separately in each part, and the statistic is the ratio of the largest to the smallest error scale.

  • kah3.test(): least squares fits; the statistic follows Hartley's maximum F distribution with three groups exactly, so p-values and critical values come from one numerical integral.
  • kah.robust.test(): least trimmed squares fits; resists outliers, with an effective-degrees-of-freedom maximum F reference (default), a Monte Carlo reference, or a residual bootstrap for non-normal errors.
  • run.all.het(): runs both tests next to the Goldfeld–Quandt, Breusch–Pagan, White and modified Goldfeld–Quandt tests.
  • pfmax(), dfmax(), qfmax(), rfmax(): Hartley's maximum F distribution for any number of groups and any positive degrees of freedom.
